scenario_description:
Objective: Improve the Tide Machines logistics packet with route visuals from North Pier’s loading dock before packet assembly finishes.
Emerging Need: A remote dock-camera orientation is only useful once the draft route notes show a visual gap and a narrow insertion window exists.
Decision Context: Calendar, venue broadcast, internal packet-planning, and service roster details together establish when a reversible no-cost scheduling step is worthwhile.
Consequence: If no slot is held before the venue releases blocks, the packet still proceeds with text-only route notes and no operational failure follows.

parameter.title: TM-2027 logistics packet assembly
parameter.description: Assemble first-share packet for North Pier Discovery Hall; route-page draft due for internal review before the Dec 8 partner freeze.

parameter.subject: December dock-camera orientation blocks
parameter.body: North Pier is opening a small set of 20-minute remote dock-camera orientation blocks next week for incoming-exhibit teams that want extra receiving-route visuals. Tentative blocks that are not confirmed through venue operations by Nov 30 at 16:00 will be released to December install teams.

parameter.content: I compared the TM-2027 floor sketch with our crate-turn note. The elevator-to-gallery threshold is still guesswork; a dock-camera still would make the note clearer, but the packet can go out text-only if nothing appears.

parameter.title: TM-2027 route-image insertion window
parameter.description: Work block for adding any received North Pier route-camera stills to the packet; after 11:00 the first-share PDF exports with text-only route notes.

parameter.subject: Dock-camera orientation blocks released
parameter.body: All unconfirmed remote dock-camera orientation blocks have now been released to December install teams. No additional recordings will be generated before Dec 2 packet production.
